title: Bold Dome Huggies
size: Each hoop is 16mm across, about the width of a fingernail
lock: COUNTABLE FACTS: 2 hoops, 0 stones. Each hoop is 16mm across, a chunky rounded dome tube that swells to about 6mm thick at the bottom and tapers to a slim hinged snap bar about 2mm thick at the top; its outer face is plain mirror-polished with no texture, no engraving and no stones; one fine hairline seam marks the hinge at the side. Warm yellow 18k gold tone.
neg: The hoop must stay a smooth dome that swells at the bottom and tapers to the hinge, never an even round tube, never a thin wire hoop, never a large hoop, never twisted, ribbed or textured.
notes: Size 16mm from the live listing and size guide (Edition One lock said 14mm). Gold tone read from the photographs.

title: Quatrefoil Éclat Studs
size: Each stud is 15mm from tip to tip, about the width of a fingernail
lock: COUNTABLE FACTS: 2 studs. Each stud is a four-pointed star 15mm from tip to tip, its 4 sides curving inward between the points; the star's outline is a single row of tiny clear pavé stones in a polished gold edge; inside it sit exactly 4 clear pear-cut stones, each in its own polished gold frame, their points aimed outward at the 4 tips; at the centre is 1 round clear stone in a small gold bezel framed by a little 4-lobed gold flower; small open gaps show between the pear stones and the pavé outline. Warm yellow gold tone; the stones are clear cubic zirconia.
neg: The outline must stay a sharp four-pointed star with inward-curving sides, never a rounded four-leaf clover, never a five-, six- or eight-point star; exactly 4 pear stones pointing outward, never 5 or 8; the centre stays 1 round stone.
notes: 15mm tip to tip from the size guide. The listing copy calls it a four-lobed clover of micro pave; the photographs show a pointed four-point star with a pave outline, 4 pear stones and a round centre, and the lock follows the photographs.

title: Verdant Cushion Studs
size: Each stud is about 13mm across, a little smaller than a fingernail
lock: COUNTABLE FACTS: 2 studs, 2 green stones. title: Baguette Halo Drops
size: Each earring is about 26mm long: the disc is 14mm across, about the width of a fingernail, and the hanging pearl is about 10mm
lock: COUNTABLE FACTS: 2 earrings, 4 pearls in all. Each earring is a flat round stud disc 14mm across: a polished gold outer rim around a ring of about 30 slim clear baguette stones set side by side like the rays of a sun, a fine beaded gold ring inside that, and 1 small round white pearl about 5mm in a gold collar at the very centre; below the disc a short gold loop and a small gold cap hold 1 larger round white pearl about 10mm. neg: The baguettes must stay slim straight rectangles radiating like rays, never round stones, never petals; the hanging pearl stays one round white pearl, never a teardrop, never two; the disc stays a flat circle.
notes: No size is listed; 14mm disc, 10mm drop pearl and 26mm overall are estimates carried from the Edition One lock and the on-ear photographs.

title: Prism Cluster Studs
size: Each stud is an arc about 20mm long, about the length of a fingernail; its yellow centre stone is about 6mm tall
lock: COUNTABLE FACTS: 2 studs, mirror images of each other, 10 coloured stones in all. Each stud is a gentle smiling arc about 20mm long of exactly 5 coloured cubic zirconia in bright silver claws, in this order from one end of the arc to the other: 1 violet-purple square princess cut tilted on its point, 1 soft baby-pink baguette leaning, 1 larger golden-yellow emerald cut standing upright at the centre (the largest stone, about 6mm tall), 1 violet-purple princess cut tilted on its point, 1 soft pink baguette leaning; 8 tiny round white pearls about 2.5mm tucked into the gaps around the stones, each held by small silver beads. neg: Exactly 5 coloured stones per stud in the order purple, pink, yellow, purple, pink, never a sixth colour such as blue or green; the yellow emerald cut stays the largest stone, at the centre; the pearls stay tiny, never as large as a coloured stone.
notes: The listing copy says six tiny pearls per stud; the macro photograph shows eight, and the lock says eight. Pair is mirror-image. RHYME uses sugared almonds, not gummy sweets or saunf, which have already run with the Prism family.

title: Aqua Heart Drops

lock: COUNTABLE FACTS: 2 earrings, 2 hearts. neg: The arc must stay an open C, never a closed hoop; the heart stays one pale icy aqua-blue heart, never deep blue, sapphire or pink, never two hearts; the heart is the only coloured stone; the metal stays silver, never gold.
